question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Polite
solution:
The correct answer is option 1), i.e., 'Rude .'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the meanings of the given word and marked option:

 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 Polite
 having or showing behaviour that is respectful and considerate of other people. (विनम्र)
 
 

 Rude 
 offensively impolite or ill-mannered. (असभ्य, अशिष्ट, रूखा)
 
 
 
 

 

 
• ​​Let's look at the meanings of the other given options:

 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 Civil
 courteous and polite; relating to ordinary citizens and their concerns. (नागरिक, सभ्य)
 
 

 Decent
 socially acceptable or good. (सभ्य, उचित, शिष्ट, प्रतिष्ठित, सम्माननीय)
 
 

 Sober
 not affected by alcohol; serious and sensible in demeanour or behaviour. (शांत, संयमी, गंभीर)
 
 
 
 
 
• Hence from the given meanings, we find that 'Polite' and 'Rude ' are antonyms.
 
• So, the correct answer is option 1.
